title: Front matter of a decision record
description: The YAML front matter of a record in docs/decisions/ (MADR 4.0.0). A record may hold other keys, such as `domain`. The format is in docs/reference/decision-records.md, and the decisions check validates every record against this schema.

status.description: Whether the decision is made. A replaced record is deleted and listed in the ledger, so there is no `superseded` status.

date.description: The day the record was last updated, as YYYY-MM-DD.

decision-makers.description: Who decides: one name, or a list of at least one name.

consulted.description: Whose opinion was sought, with two-way communication: one name, or a list that may be empty.

informed.description: Who is kept up to date, with one-way communication: one name, or a list that may be empty.

person.description: The name of a person or a group.

people.description: One name, or a list of names that may be empty.
